entries.name: PROV-O provenance ontology

entries.name: SHACL vocabulary
entries.versionBasis: Source header explicitly says Version from 2017-07-20; Recommendation is not evidence of newer draft conformance.

licence.basis: Source file contains no licence declaration; Recommendation document copyright alone was not treated as a schema derivative grant. Rights admission unresolved.

norn.overlap: External RDF shape constraints, not the Rust checker or Norn authorization authority.

priority.reason: Provenance, policy and consent support audit and reuse.

entries.notes: Vocabulary is not the complete SHACL conformance algorithm. Do not assume open-world OWL axioms and closed-world SHACL constraints are interchangeable. Redistribution: unverified.

entries.name: SKOS core vocabulary

priority.reason: Provenance, policy and consent support audit and reuse.

entries.notes: Formalisation expresses a subset of SKOS semantic conditions, as the file itself states. closeMatch, exactMatch and OWL equivalence remain distinct. Redistribution: unverified.
